description: DotEnv loader plus specification, one CU per tree. No dependencies.
ConfLoader plus deletion of the classpath application.conf, one CU per tree. Must precede Env, which resolves configuration through it.
Env.load three-tier precedence against conf/, plus object-store keys, one CU per tree.
hadoop-aws dependency and Spark fs.s3a wiring, one CU per tree. Depends on EnvConfig carrying the object-store fields.
Readiness ports, probes, gate and specification, one CU per tree. Enrichment adds the opencode CLI probe.
Entry-point startup gate, one CU per tree. Depends on AppContainer readiness from waves 4 and 5.
